接口 BooleanType

  • 所有超级接口:
    Mirror, PrimitiveType, Type
    所有已知实现类:

    @Exported
public interface BooleanType
extends PrimitiveType
    The type of all primitive boolean values accessed in the target VM. Calls to Value.type() will return an implementor of this interface.
